title: Load the active local model on first streamed inference
goal: Ensure Chatbot streaming lazily loads the selected local GGUF model at inference time and returns real output instead of failing because the engine is still unloaded.
context: DynamicActiveProvider.complete loads the selected engine before local inference, and DynamicActiveProvider.stream now resolves the active local engine and loads it before invoking the streaming adapter. The regression test proves lazy load at inference time and verifies remote streaming does not access local storage.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify App/ or PersonalAgent.xcodeproj.
Do not load local models at app startup or change remote-provider routing.
Do not weaken provider policy, cancellation, output validation, or fail-closed behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The selected local engine remains unloaded until local inference starts.
The streaming path loads the active local engine before calling its stream method.
A regression test proves first local streaming inference loads the engine exactly once and returns its response.
Remote streaming continues to avoid local storage and model loading.
